questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

B E _ K D F _ H K D J E H _ D _ E H K D
questions.solution:
Given: B E _ K D F _ H K D J E H _ D _ E H K D

Let's check each option:

1) J P K B → B E __**J**__ K D - F **__P__** H K D - J E H __**K**__ D - __**B**__ E H K D

2) **H E K N** → B E __H__ K D - F __E__ H K D - J E H __K__ D - __N__ E H K D

__
 
• ​Here 1st letter is increased by +4.

 
 
• B + 4 = F; F +4 = J; J + 4 = N
 
 

3) H B P J → B E H__ K D - F __B__ H K D - J E H __P__ D - __J__ E H K D

4) I L P K → B E **__I__** K D - F **__L__** H K D - J E H __P__ D - **__K__** E H K D

Hence, ‘ H E K N ’ is the correct answer.

Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements**:

All cranes are bears.

Some tigers are cranes.

All jackals are tigers.

**Conclusions**:

I. Some bears are tigers.

II. All jackals are bears.

III. Some jackals are bears.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Statements:

All cranes are bears.

Some tigers are cranes.

All jackals are tigers.

__Venn diagram:__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fd42acb537c14a722c7fb99bc7a2fae45f581f102c2b63bc3ed942f9fced2f9.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some bears are tigers. → Follow → (As all cranes are bears and some tigers are cranes. So, some bears are tigers is definite follow)

II. All jackals are bears. → Does not follow → (As some bears are tigers and all jackals tigers. So all jackals are bears is possible but not definite follow)

III. Some jackals are bears. → Does not follow → (As all jackals are tigers and some tiger are bears. So some jackals are bears is possible but not definite follow)

Hence, the correct answer is “Only conclusion I follows”.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(90, 15, 21)

(16, 2, 10)

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic: First number ÷ Second number = Result + Second number = Third letter**

(90, 15, 21) → 90 ÷ 15 = **6**; 15 + **6** = 21

And,

(16, 2, 10) → 16 ÷ 2 = **8**; 2 + **8** = 10

Similarly,

**(46, 23, 25) → 46 ÷ 23 = 2; 23 + 2 = 25**

**Hence, "(46, 23, 25)" **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must NOT be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Castle : Building :: Sedan : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Castle : Building → **Castle** is a **type** of **Building**.

Similarly,

**Sedan : Car** → **Sedan** is a **type** of **Car**.

Hence, **Car** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to replace the * signs and to balance the given equation.

2 * 7 * 3 * 21 * 2 * 23
questions.solution:
**Explanation:**

According to BODMAS rule

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61fc71a40c5793c0805007c8f7f5fb9f077ed2a53f61a98c33e80ec57f9461c5.png] 

Given equation: 2 * 7 * 3 * 21 * 2 * 23

Option 1 : ×, –, +, =, ×

By BODMAS rule 

⇒ **2 × 7 ** – 3 + 21 = 2 × 23

⇒ **14** - 3 + **21** = 46

⇒ 35 - 3 = 46

⇒ 32 ≠ 46 ( LHS ≠ RHS )

 

**Option 2 : ×, ×, –, +, =**

 

**By BODMAS rule **

⇒ **2 × 7 × 3** – 21 + 2 ** = **23

⇒ **42 **- 21 **+ 2 =** 23

⇒ **44 - 21 = **23** **

⇒ **23 = 23 ( LHS = RHS )**

 

Option 3 : ×, ×, =, +, –

By BODMAS rule

⇒ 2 × 7 × 3 = **21 + 2 ** – 23

⇒ 42 = 23 - 23

⇒ 42 ≠ 0 ( LHS ≠ RHS )

 

Option 4 : +, +, +, = , +

By BODMAS rule

 2 + 7 + 3 + 21 = 2 + 23

33 ≠ 25 (LHS ≠ RHS )

 

Hence,** ×, ×, –, +, =** is the correct answer.
